column3: “Stands over” is rendered “stands guard over”; “scroll” is rendered “book,” and “escape” “be rescued.”
“The ground of dust” is rendered “the dust of the ground”; “reproaches to abhorrence” is rendered “disgrace and everlasting contempt,” with “and.”
“The firmament” is rendered “the expanse of heaven”; “turn to righteousness” is rendered “lead … to righteousness.”
“Keep secret” is rendered “conceal,” and “scroll” “book”; “rove about” is rendered “go back and forth.”
“Someone said” is rendered “one said”; NASB adds “it be until” and “these.”
“The living one of perpetuity” is rendered “Him who lives forever”; “the hand” is rendered “the power,” and “things” “events.”
“Go” is rendered “Go your way,” and “the things” “these words.”
The Hebrew reflexive verbs are rendered as passives (“will be purged”).
“The perpetual” is rendered “the regular sacrifice,” and “the abomination desolating” “the abomination of desolation.”
NASB adds “your way” and “then”; “arise to your portion” is rendered “rise again for your allotted portion,” and “end of the days” “end of the age.”
